note: Standard buys. Item ids are weapons.vdata names; build.py adds the prices from the game files and fails if an id has no card. These are the usual shapes of a buy, not a ranking of guns: which rifle or SMG to pick is a preference.

loadouts.name: T full buy
loadouts.when: When every T can pay for it. Kill rewards with a rifle are $300.

loadouts.name: CT full buy (M4A1-S)
loadouts.when: When every CT can pay for it. Keep the kit: it halves the defuse time.
q: The time it takes to defuse C4 is 10 seconds or 5 seconds with a defuse kit

loadouts.name: CT full buy (M4A4)
loadouts.when: Same round as the M4A1-S buy; the M4A4 has a bigger magazine, the M4A1-S more damage per bullet (see the weapon cards).

loadouts.name: AWP buy (CT)
loadouts.when: For the team's sniper in a full-buy round. AWP kills pay only $100.

loadouts.name: AWP buy (T)
loadouts.when: For the team's sniper in a full-buy round. AWP kills pay only $100.

loadouts.name: T force buy (Galil AR)
loadouts.when: When the team cannot full buy but must win this round.

loadouts.name: CT force buy (FAMAS)
loadouts.when: When the team cannot full buy but must win this round.

loadouts.name: T SMG force (MAC-10)
loadouts.when: Cheap force; SMG kills pay $600, so a won fight helps the next buy.

loadouts.name: CT SMG force (MP9)
loadouts.when: Cheap force; SMG kills pay $600, so a won fight helps the next buy.

loadouts.name: Eco with armor (T)
loadouts.when: A save round where you still want to fight close up.

loadouts.name: Eco with armor (CT)
loadouts.when: A save round where you still want to fight close up.

loadouts.name: Pistol round: armor
loadouts.when: Round one or thirteen: you have $800.

loadouts.name: Pistol round: P250 and grenades
loadouts.when: Round one or thirteen without armor: you have $800.

loadouts.name: Pistol round: CT kit
loadouts.when: One CT per team, so a planted bomb can be defused in 5 seconds.
q: The time it takes to defuse C4 is 10 seconds or 5 seconds with a defuse kit

roles.name: In-game leader (IGL)
roles.what: Calls the strategy, the buy and the mid-round decisions for the team.
q: calling the strats and reading the midgame

tips.t: Set up a default that gathers information, then turn it into a committed hit once the information arrives.
q: Setting up the passive shape that gathers information, then converting it into a committed hit once the information arrives

tips.t: Plan the team's money two rounds ahead: when to save, when to force.
q: Deciding when the team saves, when it forces, and what it can afford two rounds ahead

tips.t: Take this role if you already know why rounds are lost.
q: Lead if you already know why rounds are lost

roles.name: Entry
roles.what: First player into a site: takes the first fight so teammates can trade.
q: The entry is the first player into contested space

tips.t: Have your crosshair at head height on the angle before you cross it.
q: Your crosshair is at head height on the angle before you cross it, or you lose

tips.t: Go in with a teammate right behind you: a death that gets traded is a success.
q: An entry without a teammate right behind them is just a player dying first
Deaths that were traded were successes

tips.t: Take entry if aim is your strength and losing duels does not tilt you.
q: Take entry if your aim is your strength and losing duels does not tilt you

roles.name: Sniper (AWPer)
roles.what: Buys the [[AWP]] in full-buy rounds and holds or takes long angles. prosettings lists it as Sniper.
q: Control sightlines, stall pushes

tips.t: On CT, take one shot, then reposition.
q: One shot, then reposition

tips.t: Buy it consistently if you take the role: an [[AWP]] kill pays only $100.
q: Buy it consistently
returns only $100 per kill

tips.t: Play positions over flicks: the [[AWP]] is only truly accurate scoped and standing still.
q: Positioning beats flicking
The AWP is only truly accurate scoped and stationary

roles.name: Support
roles.what: Throws the smokes and flashes for the entry and trades kills.
q: The Support player will often be trading

tips.t: Learn five grenades on your most-played map first, starting with the standard smoke, two flashes and a molotov.
q: Learn five grenades on your most-played map
Learn the standard smoke, two flashes and a molotov on the map you queue most

tips.t: Be the trade behind the entry.
q: be the trade behind the entry

tips.t: Start here if you are new or coming back: it is the fastest way to be useful.
q: Start as support
It is the fastest route to being useful

roles.name: Lurker
roles.what: Plays away from the team to catch rotating enemies or cut them off.
q: catch the rotator who runs past them

tips.t: Time your lurk to land when the CTs commit to the other site.
q: The lurk works because it lands at the moment the CTs commit elsewhere

tips.t: Walk, do not run, so the enemy hears only what you choose.
q: Walking, not running

tips.t: Tell your team you are lurking; in solo queue, lurk only when they agree.
q: Lurk only with your team's agreement
If nobody knows you are lurking, you are not lurking

roles.name: Anchor (CT)
roles.what: Holds one bombsite alone or with one teammate and waits for help.
q: Anchors hold a bombsite alone or in a pair

tips.t: Stay alive until help arrives: you do not need to win the site alone.
q: expected to survive long enough for help to arrive, not to win outright

tips.t: Use utility that buys time, like an [[Incendiary Grenade]] into the choke.
q: Utility that buys time

tips.t: Learn every angle, timing and spot on your site.
q: As an Anchor, you need to know your bombsite inside out

roles.name: Rifler
roles.what: Every non-sniper on prosettings is listed as Rifler: entries, supports, lurkers and IGLs all rifle.

role_pick.t: Start as support: learn five grenades on your most-played map and trade for your teammates. Take entry if aim is your strength. Take the [[AWP]] only if you will commit to it.
q: Start as support
Learn five grenades on your most-played map
Take entry if your aim is your strength
Take the AWP only if you will commit to it
